m1.typescript: m1 a full run with agreement returns claims with every source and a complete status

e1.typescript: e1 no results leave every scope a gap and say not researched

e2.typescript: e2 a scope the plan never covered and a scope whose search failed read differently in the note

e3.typescript: e3 two values for one claim are a conflict that names both sources and no claim

e4.typescript: e4 partial results are kept and flagged but do not cover the scope and a retry that worked clears the error

e5.typescript: e5 a result with no findings does not cover its scope

e6.typescript: e6 claims sources and scopes come out in a fixed order without duplicates

wrong-empty-run-complete.defect: calls a run with no results complete

wrong-conflict-first-wins.defect: keeps the first value of a claim and drops the other source

wrong-partial-covers.defect: counts a scope with only partial results as covered

wrong-empty-covers.defect: counts a scope whose result holds no findings as covered

wrong-partial-dropped.defect: drops the partial findings of a failed search

wrong-resolved-error-kept.defect: keeps the error of a scope that a later result covered

wrong-sources-duplicated.defect: lists the same source twice for one claim

wrong-claims-unsorted.defect: returns the claims in the order they arrived

wrong-note-drops-query.defect: leaves the query out of the note for a scope whose search failed

wrong-partial-flag-any.defect: flags a claim as partial when any of its findings was partial
